description: A person as one glance: avatar beside name and secondary line — the face next to the name, never a face floating a row above it. Consolidated from the showcase's and a second product's hand-rolled identity blocks. Copy: the name as the person writes it, and the secondary line is what they do here, not their whole title. Two lines, both short: this is a face with a name, not a profile.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's (or team's) name — the identity's strongest line. ReactNode so a card can pass its own CardTitle.

props.name: avatarName
props.description: The plain-string name the Avatar falls back to when `name` is rich markup. Required then.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Under the name: a role, an email. One line below `2xl`, where the row has to stay one row; at `2xl` the identity IS the subject of the page and the lines stack, because a profile shows the role AND the address and neither is the other's tail.

props.name: size
props.description: How big the face is. `xl` is the hero: a portrait a card is built around, which is what the vertical form is for. Avatar carries the scale; Identity only refused to ask for the top of it (owner, 2026-08-22).

props.name: vertical
props.description: A person is recognised face-BESIDE-name; `vertical` is for the one place a profile is the hero (a profile card), never for lists.

props.name: action
props.description: One control pinned to the face's trailing-bottom corner — changing the picture, and nothing else. It carries a ring in the surface colour so it reads as sitting ON the avatar rather than beside it. Three products had hand-rolled the same overlay before this existed.
